# gitdebt agent reference

Gitdebt is an open-source public GitHub repository analytics service. It provides cumulative star history, recent star velocity, contributor avatars, ownership concentration, language activity, commit cadence, high-churn files, bug-magnet files, TODO/FIXME trends, badges, profile summaries, and shareable SVG/PNG/WebP media.

## Data boundary

- Public repositories only. Private repositories are neither analyzed nor included in aggregate statistics.
- Star timelines contain timestamps and the opaque GH Archive event identifier needed for idempotency. Gitdebt does not collect actors, stargazer profiles, or event payloads.
- Complete star history and repository-health aggregates are persisted on gitdebt's server and served from Postgres-backed read paths.
- Cold work is queued. The progress endpoint reports current phase, queue position, elapsed time, and ETA.

## URL conventions

HTML is served by the site, Markdown by the API. The Markdown for any page is `https://api.gitdebt.com/api/md/{path}` for that page's site path; `https://gitdebt.com/{path}.md` is a 302 to it, kept so appending `.md` still lands on the document.

- Home: `https://gitdebt.com/` — Markdown `https://api.gitdebt.com/api/md/`
- Repository: `https://gitdebt.com/{owner}/{repo}` — Markdown `https://api.gitdebt.com/api/md/{owner}/{repo}`
- Profile: `https://gitdebt.com/{login}` — Markdown `https://api.gitdebt.com/api/md/{login}`
- Category: `https://gitdebt.com/compare/{category}` — Markdown `https://api.gitdebt.com/api/md/compare/{category}`
- Comparison: `https://gitdebt.com/vs/{owner1}/{repo1}/{owner2}/{repo2}` — Markdown `https://api.gitdebt.com/api/md/vs/{owner1}/{repo1}/{owner2}/{repo2}`
- Embed catalog: `https://gitdebt.com/badges` — Markdown `https://api.gitdebt.com/api/md/badges`
- Repository Markdown alias: `https://api.gitdebt.com/api/repos/{owner}/{repo}/report.md` renders the same document as `/api/md/{owner}/{repo}`.

Every repository shape works for ANY public repository, analyzed or not.

## Public API

- Analyze/cache snapshot: `GET https://api.gitdebt.com/api/repos/{owner}/{repo}/analyze`
- Markdown for any page: `GET https://api.gitdebt.com/api/md/{path}`
- Markdown report: `GET https://api.gitdebt.com/api/repos/{owner}/{repo}/report.md` — 200 once analyzed, 202 with `Retry-After` while the analysis it just queued runs, 404 when the repository is not public. `?enqueue=0` reads without queueing. The same statuses apply to `/api/md/{owner}/{repo}`.
- Star history JSON: `GET https://api.gitdebt.com/api/repos/{owner}/{repo}/stars.json`
- Star history CSV: `GET https://api.gitdebt.com/api/repos/{owner}/{repo}/stars.csv`
- Repository-health JSON: `GET https://api.gitdebt.com/api/repos/{owner}/{repo}/stats.json`
- Repository-health summary JSON: `GET https://api.gitdebt.com/api/repos/{owner}/{repo}/health.json`
- Progress snapshot: `GET https://api.gitdebt.com/api/repos/{owner}/{repo}/progress.json`
- Progress SSE: `GET https://api.gitdebt.com/api/repos/{owner}/{repo}/progress`
- Platform activity: `GET https://api.gitdebt.com/api/activity.json`
- Leaderboard: `GET https://api.gitdebt.com/api/leaderboard.json`

## Shareable media

- Metrics badge: `/api/repos/{owner}/{repo}/badge.svg?metrics=stars,forks`
- Signal badge: `/api/repos/{owner}/{repo}/badge.svg?signal=active|community|momentum|contributor-ready`
- Star history: `/api/repos/{owner}/{repo}/chart.svg`
- Repository card: `/api/repos/{owner}/{repo}/card.svg`
- Stars versus downloads: `/api/repos/{owner}/{repo}/usage.svg`
- Contributors: `/api/repos/{owner}/{repo}/stats/contributors.svg`
- Ownership concentration: `/api/repos/{owner}/{repo}/stats/bus-factor.svg`
- Maintenance pulse: `/api/repos/{owner}/{repo}/stats/commit-trend.svg`
- Language activity: `/api/repos/{owner}/{repo}/stats/lines.svg`
- Commit calendar: `/api/repos/{owner}/{repo}/stats/heatmap.svg`
- File change frequency: `/api/repos/{owner}/{repo}/stats/top-files.svg`
- Fix-labelled changes: `/api/repos/{owner}/{repo}/stats/bug-magnets.svg`
- TODO/FIXME movement: `/api/repos/{owner}/{repo}/stats/todo-trend.svg`
- Social preview: `/api/repos/{owner}/{repo}/og.png`
- Profile card: `/api/users/{login}/card.svg`
- Profile star history: `/api/users/{login}/chart.svg`
- Profile footprint: `/api/users/{login}/stats/{contributions|languages|commit-activity}.svg`
- Multi-repository overlay: `/api/chart.svg?repos={owner}/{repo},{owner}/{repo}`

SVG URLs accept `theme=light|dark`. Colors are baked per asset — there is no `theme=auto` — so a theme-aware README embed publishes both variants behind an HTML `<picture>` element. Static README output is the default. Use `animate=1` only when animation is explicitly wanted, or the `.gif` variant where GitHub strips SVG motion. PNG and WebP variants use the corresponding file extension.

## Embedding these in a README

`https://api.gitdebt.com/api/md/badges` is the complete catalog: every asset, a paste-ready snippet for each, the query-parameter reference, and a ready-made prompt for adding them to a repository. `https://api.gitdebt.com/api/md/{owner}/{repo}` carries the same snippets already pointed at that repository, alongside its measured star and health figures.

Rules that make a published embed correct:

- No account, token, build step, or GitHub Action is involved. Every URL is a plain public image.
- Attribution rides the surrounding link as `?ref=readme`. It never belongs in an image URL, which stays plain so CDNs can cache it.
- Do not add cache-busting parameters. Media is edge-cached for a few hours by design.
- Publish only signal badges the repository has earned; `/api/repos/{owner}/{repo}/earned-badges.json` reports which.
- A repository nobody has analyzed renders a placeholder frame and queues the work rather than failing. The real chart replaces it at the same URL.
- Replace an existing star-history widget in place rather than stacking a second chart beneath it.
